title: SG-1.4.2 · Render HeaderOverlay from App through the GameLayout header slot
summary: App renders HeaderOverlay via a GameLayout header slot using round loading/error state; old RoundBadge and Countdown usage is removed from the layout.
description: Context: HeaderOverlay exists (game/frontend/src/components/HeaderOverlay.tsx) with props worldTitle, round, loading, error, but App.tsx still renders RoundBadge and Countdown inside the scene and GameLayout has no header slot. Desired behavior: App fetches the current round, tracks loading and error, and passes a HeaderOverlay into a new GameLayout header slot. Expected result: the header shows round ID, status and countdown, or a loading or an explained error state, and the old RoundBadge and Countdown usage in App is gone. Why: the header must be a compact overlay with explained failure states.
acceptance_criteria: Given App is playing and getCurrentRound resolves, when it renders, then the header shows the round id, status and countdown from the HeaderOverlay.
Given getCurrentRound is pending, when App renders, then the header shows 'Loading round…'.
Given getCurrentRound rejects with an Error, when App renders, then the header alert shows 'Round unavailable: <message>'.
Given App is playing, when it renders, then no standalone RoundBadge or Countdown element is rendered outside the header.

in_scope: App round loading/error state and HeaderOverlay wiring
Removal of RoundBadge and Countdown usage from App
Unit tests with api client mocked

technical_constraints: React + TypeScript + Tailwind; use the existing getCurrentRound client and HeaderOverlay component
Unit tests use vitest with dependencies mocked
definition_of_done: All requirements implemented and unit tests green
